description: One page of the book catalog for a language. Large languages are paginated (for example en = 25 pages x 2500 books); small languages are a single shard. When to use: browse or sample what a language holds, or locate a book title. Do not use: to search by keyword across the whole corpus (that is the planned cyberlibrary_fulltext_search) or to get one book's metadata when you already know its slug (call cyberlibrary_book_meta). Returns: {lang, page, total_pages, total_items, count, books[]} with books trimmed to `limit`.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, zh-cn, zh-tw, de.

name: cyberlibrary_language_shard
title: Cyberlibrary Language Shard
